in_hebrew.name: Godber
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Godber הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'Godbeorht', meaning 'God's berry'. This name was given to children born in the presence of God or as a reminder of His divine protection.

in_greek.name: Godber
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's berry
in_greek.long_meaning: Godber είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English 'Godbeorht', meaning 'God's berry'. This name was given to children born in the presence of God or as a reminder of His divine protection.

in_latin.name: Godber
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's berry
in_latin.long_meaning: Godber est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English 'Godbeorht', meaning 'God's berry'. This name was given to children born in the presence of God or as a reminder of His divine protection.
